name: Credential Manager Access By Uncommon Applications
description:
Detects suspicious processes based on name and location that access the windows credential manager and vault.
Which can be a sign of credential stealing. Example case would be usage of mimikatz "dpapi::cred" function
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate software installed by the users for example in the "AppData" directory may access these files (for any reason).
query: (file.path:(*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Credentials\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Credentials\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Vault\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Vault\\*)) AND (NOT (process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\system32\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*)))
